It serves as a reminder of the important role coal played in shaping industrial societies and economies. This name also represents the resilience, determination, and grit of those who worked in such hazardous conditions to provide for themselves and their families.

It can serve as a reminder of the divine providence that protects and guides us through even the most challenging experiences. Coleman can also be seen as an invitation to embrace hard work and find meaning and purpose in every task, although it may be dull, laborious, and thankless.
